text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, almost the same as before.
My lap times are stabilizing."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It seems my theory was correct...
Let's go for one more lap...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, I changed my mind.
We're adding more training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Give me something that'll wear me down to the very bone.
Otherwise—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"The fire that was lit in my chest
just won't go out, you see...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We continued extra self-training until Narita Brian was thoroughly satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No good. It's meaningless unless it's right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I told her that it's much more efficient
to train after getting some rest rather than on a tired body."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Talking about efficiency... You sound just like big sis.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch, fine, I get it.
In exchange, give me a tough workout tomorrow.
